title: 군무원 특별채용 등에 관한 특례규정 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 6 (Appointment by Promotion)
(1) In assessing the career of a person specially recruited under Article 14 (2) of the Addenda to the Act, notwithstanding Article 26 (2) of the Regulations on Performance Evaluation, etc. of Public Officials, career in the civilian military employee grade held at the time of special recruitment and in the immediately lower civilian military employee grade shall be deemed career in the grade after special recruitment and the immediately lower grade, respectively.
(2) In calculating the minimum years required for promotion of a person specially recruited under Article 14 (2) of the Addenda to the Act, notwithstanding Article 31 (9) of the Decree on Appointment of Public Officials, the period served as a civilian military employee at or above the grade corresponding to the relevant class shall be included in the minimum years required for promotion in that class.
